description: This file defines the class 'MonkeySourceScript', which is responsible for reading and parsing script files containing sequences of input events (such as key presses, touch events, rotations, etc.) for automated testing of Android applications. It converts script lines into specific MonkeyEvent objects and manages event timing and queueing.

classes.name: MonkeySourceScript
classes.description: A class that reads scripted input events from a file and converts them into MonkeyEvent objects for simulated user interaction testing.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next event from the script, adjusting timing as necessary and reading more script data when needed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the script file can be opened and if its header is valid.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for logging.
